meta.name: gog
meta.description: Google Workspace CLI for Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets, and Docs.

copy.tagline: 用命令行管理 Google Workspace 各项服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果习惯用终端处理日常工作
copy.tagline_en: Manage Google Workspace services via command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer terminal for daily work

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可通过命令行工具 `gog` 操作 Google Workspace（Gmail、日历、云端硬盘、联系人、表格、文档），例如搜索邮件、发送邮件、查看日历事件、管理表格数据等。需先完成 OAuth 设置。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 Google Workspace 任务时触发，如搜索邮件、发送邮件、查看日历、操作云端硬盘文件、管理联系人或表格数据等。需已安装 `gog` 并完成认证。

say.text: 帮我搜索Gmail中最近7天的邮件
say.note: 将执行 gog gmail search 命令。

say.text: 发一封邮件给a@b.com，标题Hi，内容Hello
say.note: 将执行 gog gmail send 命令。

say.text: 查看我日历中今天的事件
say.note: 将执行 gog calendar events 命令。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can operate Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets, Docs) via the `gog` CLI, e.g., search/send emails, view calendar events, manage sheets data. Requires prior OAuth setup.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for Google Workspace tasks such as searching/sending emails, viewing calendar, managing Drive files, contacts, or sheets. Requires `gog` installed and authenticated.

say_en.text: Search my Gmail for emails from the last 7 days.
Send an email to a@b.com with subject 'Hi' and body 'Hello'.
Show today's events from my calendar.
